notes_for_editor: Only the provincial tower-layer record names this tower. Two WebSearch calls, one Wikipedia search and the lookout directories returned nothing on Castlebar Tower. The only Castlebar hit was an unrelated lodge near Caramat, which is not a source for this tower. The record has no height, construction date, agency or status, and the layer's accuracy field reads Data Load, so the position may be rough. The story sits below the usual 120-word floor and mostly describes the layer entry. Context paragraph is province-wide, not specific to this tower. Editor may prefer to hold the story until a history source turns up.
